h1: Company Van Wraps: A Real-World Case
estratto: Bespoke graphics, quality printing and careful application: how a van becomes advertising on the road.

paragrafi: A well-wrapped van isn't just a means of transport: it's advertising that drives around Ticino every single day, with no recurring costs. Here's how we turned a professional painter's van into a true business card on wheels, from concept to the open road.

sezioni.heading: The project: a trade told across the bodywork
paragrafi: The client wanted a vehicle that instantly conveyed energy and precision. That's where the idea came from: a design built around a broad brushstroke of deep and light blue, with splashes of paint that bring the side panel to life.
The company logo stands out on the side of the van, heightened by the contrast with the paint splashes. The result is elegant yet striking, recognisable even from a distance and on the move.

sezioni.heading: Graphics, printing and materials
paragrafi: The design grew out of close collaboration with the client, balancing colours, shapes and the placement of each element for the best possible visibility on the road. When it comes to printing and materials, we focus on durability:
lista: High-definition printing, to reproduce every shade of blue with true-to-life accuracy.
Professional weatherproof films that hold their colour and shine for years.
Crisp, well-defined details for a clean visual impact across the entire bodywork.

sezioni.heading: Careful application, a 5-star result
paragrafi: The application matters just as much as the design. We worked on precise alignment, seamless integration of the paint splashes and a uniform finish, with no bubbles or imperfections.

The client left a 5-star review on Google: they praised the collaborative process, the quality of the printing and materials, and the care taken in the application. Now their van is a marketing tool that works every time it leaves the job site.

sezioni.heading: Conclusion
paragrafi: A thoughtfully wrapped company vehicle enhances your brand and gets you noticed on the road every day. With well-crafted graphics and quality materials, your van becomes advertising in motion.
Want to give your vehicle a strong identity? Get in touch for a free consultation on wrapping your company van in Ticino.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to wrap a company van?
faq.risposta: It depends on the size of the vehicle and the type of work involved. A partial wrap with a logo and lettering costs less than a full wrap that covers most of the bodywork. We'll put together a tailored quote based on your van and the design you have in mind.

faq.domanda: How long does a van wrap last?
faq.risposta: With professional films (3M, Avery, Oracal) and normal maintenance, a wrap keeps its colour and shine for around 5-7 years. Its lifespan depends on sun exposure, the weather and how well the vehicle is looked after.

faq.domanda: Does the film damage the van's paintwork?
faq.risposta: No. When applied and removed correctly, the film actually protects the original paint from scratches and wear. Once it's removed, the bodywork is left in excellent condition.

faq.domanda: Is a partial or full wrap better?
faq.risposta: A partial wrap (logo, text and graphics on the doors and rear) is understated and cost-effective. A full wrap covers large areas of the bodywork for maximum visual impact. The right choice depends on your budget and the effect you're after.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to wrap a van?
faq.risposta: A partial wrap usually takes 1-2 working days. Complex graphics or extensive coverage need a few days more. On top of this, allow for the graphic design phase, which we plan out together.
